analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($673.24) vs SMA5 ($683.21)/SMA20 ($692.96)/SMA50 ($700.73): confirmed below short-to-mid term trends.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($697.86)/SMA200 ($670.93): diagnosed as mid-to-long term weak trend.

[Momentum Indicators]

· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.8624→-1.8866): worsening continuation, diagnosed as bearish convergence.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $669.64): band width 6.73% suggests potential for increased volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]

· Swing resistance ($689.10): based on Pivot R1 and 5-day high.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Lower High, 5-day low below 20-day low): confirmed continuation of downtrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.48x): reduced confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (downtrend): conditions for maintaining a wait-and-see approach confirmed.
